study: v31 diagnostic of first permuted-uniform collapse
registration: After observing the first seed42/round1 proposal collapse, before additional logit inference. Descriptive development-only analysis; no new checkpoint or threshold is selected.
cohorts: First32 stored round1 training examples in immutable file order, plus first32 original proposal admissions in ranked and fixed-permuted views. No selection by label or prediction, no guard/test reads.
analysis: Extract probabilities of token1 versus token0 at exactly20 output decision positions. Teacher forcing is an oracle diagnostic, not deployable prediction. Zero-prefix context does not use labels and is a diagnostic conditional score, not claimed joint generation. Report conditional binary BCE/AUROC/Brier, positive/negative mean probabilities, >=0.5 decision fraction, constant train-prevalence control and gold mask cardinalities. Verify prompt/target prefix alignment and all decision-token locations.
controls: Read all200 already saved proposal outputs, verify their parsed mask and semantic emptiness independently. Constant-zero microF1 and constant train-prevalence loss are explanatory baselines, not new agent results.
limits: Small deterministic diagnostic subset, post-observation hypothesis, no unique causal attribution from correlation. No refit, no real test, no change to ongoing frozen v31 study.
